# Skanskas vd om satsningen på datacenterr: "Diskussion om tillgång på elkraft"

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-06-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this interview, Skanska CEO Anders Danielsson describes the company's exposure to the AI-driven data center and semiconductor fab boom. Skanska took about SEK 7bn of such orders in Q1 out of SEK 38bn total, and about SEK 20bn of roughly SEK 180bn over the last 12 months. He says demand has stabilised at a high level with no slowdown in the 12-month outlook, and that US traditional infrastructure is also strong, including a new SEK 4.6bn New York subway contract. He names power availability and slow permitting, especially in Europe, as the main bottlenecks, and presents Skanska as diversified and protected against counterparty risk. Hosts did not give an explicit investment view.

#### Reasoning

The positive view comes from the company's own CEO, not the hosts or an analyst, so it is promotional rather than an independent call. Data center and fab orders are about 11% of rolling orders (~20bn of 180bn). The CEO says the segment has stabilised at a high level rather than still growing, sees no slowdown over his 12-month outlook, and says projects are funded before contracts are signed and paid as work proceeds.
